title: 84-year-old Arkansas widow returns to work to pay husband's medical bills, friend raises $31,000 to help her retire
summary_full: After the loss of her husband Gene, Sue Webb struggled with overwhelming medical debt. Even in retirement, she chose to work at the Department of Veterans Affairs to pay off her expenses. A friend’s fundraiser raised more than $31,000, significantly easing her financial strain. With these funds, Webb could retire peacefully and concentrate on her well-being, shedding light on the challenges caregivers encounter and the costs associated with medical treatments.
